objective: Gate4B1B Mutation R1: integrar el runtime canonico de slots al flujo real del Universal Worker de forma estrictamente serial y fail-closed. Crear exactamente un slot por job (readonly-1 para modos no mutantes y mutation-1 para los demas), marcar RUNNING, mantener current_job_id como proyeccion legacy, marcar TERMINALIZING y liberar el slot al terminalizar. No activar paralelismo. Mantener READ_ONLY=1, MUTATION=1, GLOBAL_GIT_WRITER, Agent Guard, Artifact Guard, divergence guards y lifecycle semantics sin debilitarlos.

constraints: Do not weaken Repository Artifact Guard
Do not weaken Git divergence guards
Exactly one runtime slot may be active because dispatcher execution remains serial
Existing slot file must fail closed with SLOT_ALREADY_CLAIMED
Slot must transition CLAIMED to RUNNING to TERMINALIZING then release
Slot release failure must fail certification but must not bypass terminal result handling
No runtime slot files may be committed
